reason: Mostly additive settings/view changes with safe defaults, but TitlePart.Edit.cshtml uses `Model.Settings.Placeholder` without the null-conditional operator used elsewhere on the same line, risking a NullReferenceException when rendering the widely-used TitlePart if Settings is ever null.
